claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine, in excellent condition and ready for work.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show DAF 24-valve engine components/valve covers, but do not show running/road test or condition proof.
No performance test results (start/run, compression, leak test) shown in the witness report.
No import documents, VIN/engine number plate, or Belgium shipment evidence shown.
Photos show engine parts laid out/partially disassembled; no video/audio of start-up or knock test.
No odometer/hours meter reading or service record shown.
Photos show valve covers and surrounding components, but do not confirm whether seals/fasteners indicate prior opening.

risks.risk: Engine may not be complete (missing ECU/sensors/injectors/starter/alternator) or may be sold as partial assembly; photos suggest parts laid out and partially disassembled.
risks.proof: A single clear video showing the full engine as a complete unit (all major components present) plus a checklist of included parts (ECU, starter, alternator, turbo, injectors, sensors) with part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only/possibly incomplete and not guaranteed to start, with deductions for missing accessories.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (compression/leaks/internal wear). Photos cannot confirm compression, oil pressure, or whether it starts/runs under load.
risks.proof: Start-up video (cold start if possible) showing stable idle, no smoke/knock, and a short run; plus compression/leak test results screenshot or report.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as not proven working (assume rebuild/repair risk).

risks.risk: Turbo/air intake and related components may be damaged or seized; witness notes turbo/air intake area visible but no functional test.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of turbo condition (shaft play, oil leaks) and a video showing boost/air intake response during a short run.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming turbo/boost system may need service or replacement.

risks.risk: Damage not visible in photos (cracks in head/block, bent rods, broken mounts, coolant/oil leaks) could exist.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of critical areas (head/block casting, oil pan, coolant passages) and a leak test/compression test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price with allowance for hidden mechanical damage (worst-case rebuild).

risks.risk: Exact engine variant/engine code mismatch affects compatibility and resale value (DAF 24 valve is broad).
risks.proof: Photo of the engine code/ID plate and stamped engine number, plus matching to the buyer’s required DAF series.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/uncertain variant with compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Documentation/ownership/import status may be unclear (Tokunbo claim not evidenced), affecting buyer confidence and potential legal/return issues.
risks.proof: Copies/photos of import documents and engine/VIN/engine number match paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no documentation/warranty (no return confidence).

proof_requests: Send a video of the engine starting and running (cold start if possible) showing no knock/smoke and stable idle.
Provide compression test and/or leak test results (photos of gauge readings or written report).
Show clear photos of the engine code/engine number plate and any stamped identifiers.
Confirm completeness: list and photograph included parts (ECU, starter, alternator, injectors, sensors, turbo, hoses) and show them all together.
Provide service history or mileage/hours evidence (meter reading or service records).
Share import/documentation photos supporting “direct from Belgium” and any warranty/return terms.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a DAF 24-valve truck engine, but the key factors that determine price in Oyo (proven running condition, completeness, exact engine variant, and hidden damage) are not shown. Without at least a start/run proof and completeness/ID shots, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
